description: List and search this workspace's companies, filtered by industry/status/owner, sorted and paginated. Returns summary rows (id, name, industry, size, status, owner, contactCount) plus pagination { page, perPage, total }. Use get_company to fetch one company's full detail by id.

industry.description: Filter to companies in this industry. Omit for any industry.

ownerId.description: Filter to companies owned by this workspace member's user id.

page.description: 1-based page number of results to return. Default 1.

perPage.description: Number of companies per page (1-100). Default 25.

q.description: Free-text search over the company name. Omit for no text filter.

sortDir.description: Sort direction by name. Default asc.

status.description: Filter by relationship status. Omit for any. Allowed: prospect, active, inactive.

name: search_companies
title: Search companies
